name: Ethics, Responsibility and Sustainability
description: Acting responsibly and ethically in business, covering social, cultural, legal, economic, and environmental considerations.

name: Markets and Economies
description: How markets for goods, services, and resources develop and function, including market failure, externalities, and fair trade.

name: Marketing, Sales, Negotiation and Customers
description: Managing customer relationships and consumer behaviour; segmentation, targeting, and positioning; generating sales; product and service innovation.

name: Finance and Accounting
description: Sources and management of business finance; use of accounting and information systems for planning, control, decision-making, and financial risk management.

name: People and Organisational Behaviour
description: Responsible and inclusive leadership; management and development of people and organisations; employee engagement; organisational design; cross-cultural issues; equality, diversity and inclusion.

name: Operations and Business Innovation
description: Managing resources, supply chains, procurement, logistics, and outsourcing; quality systems, service excellence, and project management.

name: Data Analytics, Digital Business and Information Systems
description: Using data, statistics, and information systems to support strategic decisions; digital business and business intelligence; data-driven decision-making.

name: Business Policy and Strategy
description: Developing strategy and policy to meet stakeholder interests; risk and crisis management; business continuity planning; strategic communication.

name: Public and Non-Profit Management
description: Governance, financial management, leadership, and ethics in public-sector, voluntary, and community organisations, including hybrid delivery models.

name: Entrepreneurship and Enterprise Development
description: Developing and launching new business ideas, products, services, or ventures; identifying and valuing intellectual property; generating financial or social return.

name: People Management
description: Communication, team building, resilience and wellbeing, leadership, motivating others, and fostering equality, diversity and inclusion.

name: Problem-Solving and Critical Analysis
description: Analysing facts and circumstances to identify causes of problems, and selecting sound, sustainable solutions.

name: Research
description: Analysing and evaluating data and information sources with strong digital literacy to support ethical, evidence-based decisions.

name: Commercial Acumen
description: Understanding what drives business success and failure, and how to build customer satisfaction and loyalty sustainably.

name: Innovation, Creativity and Enterprise
description: Generating, developing, and communicating ideas entrepreneurially; managing intellectual property; delivering sustainable outcomes.

name: Numeracy
description: Using quantitative methods to manipulate data and model business problems, functions, and phenomena.

name: Networking
description: Listening, negotiating, persuasion, and presentation skills used to build and sustain business relationships.

name: Leadership
description: Working across boundaries and organisations, influencing others, and collaborating in partnerships.

name: Collaboration with Stakeholders
description: Working effectively and inclusively with internal and external stakeholders.

name: Communication (Verbal, Non-verbal, Digital)
description: Communicating clearly and appropriately across different formats and channels.

name: Empathy and Inclusivity
description: Recognising and valuing the perspectives and needs of others.

name: Digital Literacy
description: Using digital tools and platforms effectively and appropriately in a business context.

name: Critical and Systemic Thinking
description: Analysing, synthesising, and evaluating information and systems critically.

name: Self-Management
description: Working independently, taking responsibility, tolerating uncertainty, and using evidence to inform judgement.

name: Self-Reflection
description: Reflecting on one's own practice and remaining open to ongoing development.
